Senses.Explanation: A tortoise boring through a wall is comically slow force accomplishing an impossible breach. Chan masters give it after long-duration or “today’s affair” questions, yet also say that even sorting out the presented scene may amount only to this laborious breakthrough. Sanyi Yu says that even correctly sorting the rainy-day scene is a tortoise boring through the wall. Changqing Huileng answers “what is today’s affair?” with the phrase after asking what differs across immeasurable ages. Yunfeng Wenyue preserves the same duration-and-today formula in a separate record. Sanyi Yu later gives the phrase after a respondent asks him to return to the quarters.

Senses.Explanation: The canon librarian is the monastic officer responsible for the scripture store and its collection. Liao’an Qingyu and Chushi Fanqi address identifiable holders of this office within working monasteries, while Gulin Qingmao’s documentary material places it among appointed posts. The title names a person responsible for the canon store, not the canon itself and not every monk who reads scripture.
